answer: Reaching eligibility takes 20 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. The meadow register is checked at draw time, glacier lists the eligible set, and island seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 20 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
